request.text: One original isolated close-up sound effect for a hand-painted insect-fantasy action game. No music, rhythm, melody, voices, speech, electronic alert beep or background ambience. Clean onset, natural physical detail, short controlled decay. A heavy broad bladed weapon swinging with the body's weight: low airy whoom followed by a dry metallic edge sweep. Organic and weighty, not a cinematic explosion. No hit impact. Texture variation: tight and precise articulation.
